hooks.command: bash -c 'p=$(cat); sid="$PODIUM_SESSION_ID"; s="$PODIUM_CODEX_HOOK_SOCKET"; u="$PODIUM_CODEX_HOOK_URL"; if [ -n "$s" ] && [ -n "$sid" ]; then printf %s "$p" | curl -fsS -m 2 --unix-socket "$s" -X POST -H "content-type: application/json" --data-binary @- "http://localhost/hooks/$sid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; elif [ -n "$u" ]; then printf %s "$p" | curl -fsS -m 2 -X POST -H "content-type: application/json" --data-binary @- "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi'
hooks.commandWindows: if defined PODIUM_CODEX_HOOK_URL (curl.exe -fsS -m 2 -X POST -H "content-type: application/json" --data-binary @- "%PODIUM_CODEX_HOOK_URL%" >NUL 2>&1) else (more >NUL) & exit /b 0
